01-cubo-vecinos.svg.Las ocho cadenas de 3 bits como vértices: The eight 3-bit strings as cube vertices, with arrows to better neighbors
01-cubo-vecinos.svg.Cada vértice es una cadena con su valor: Each vertex is a string with its f value; edges connect strings differing in one bit. An arrow points to the best neighbor if that neighbor is better: 000 to 100; 001 to 011; 010 to 110; 100 to 110; 101 to 100; and 111 to 110. Neither 011 nor 110 has an outgoing arrow: they are local optima, and 110, with f = 6, is global. Following arrows from 001 reaches 011; from the other five strings it reaches 110.

01-paisaje.svg.Dos búsquedas que pasan siempre al mejor: Two searches that always move to the best neighbor in a two-peak landscape
01-paisaje.svg.Valor de la función objetivo, que se qui: Objective values to be maximized for 21 solutions, from x = 0 to x = 20. Adjacent solutions are neighbors. There are two peaks: a local optimum at x = 5 with f = 7.0, and the global optimum at x = 15 with f = 10.0. A search starting at x = 1 climbs to x = 5 and stops because no neighbor is better. Another starts at x = 11 and climbs to x = 15, the global optimum.
01-paisaje.svg.Empieza en x = 1 y se para en el óptimo: Starts at x = 1; stops at the local optimum
01-paisaje.svg.Empieza en x = 11 y llega al global: Starts at x = 11; reaches the global optimum

02-ciclo.svg.A la izquierda, lo que se hace una sola: On the left, one-time steps: represent the problem, create the initial population, and evaluate it. An arrow leads to Stop? If no, a generation starts: select parents, cross them, mutate offspring, evaluate offspring, and replace to form the next population and return to the question. If yes, return the best solution found.

03-genotipo-fenotipo.svg.Genotipo, fenotipo y aptitud de un indiv: An individual's genotype, phenotype, and fitness
03-genotipo-fenotipo.svg.Un cromosoma de 8 bits, 1010 0011, se de: An 8-bit chromosome, 1010 0011, decodes to point (x₁, x₂) = (1.67; −3.00), evaluated by the fitness function: f = 139.38. Crossover and mutation act on the chromosome; the fitness function acts on the decoded point.
03-genotipo-fenotipo.svg.Operan sobre los bits, sin saber qué sig: They operate on bits, unaware of their meaning.
It evaluates the solution, without seeing the bits.

03-himmelblau.svg.La función de Himmelblau en la caja de −: The Himmelblau function in the box from −5 to 5
03-himmelblau.svg.A la izquierda, la superficie de f en tr: Left: the surface of f in three dimensions. Right: its contours. Four global minima, f = 0, are marked by diamonds, each in its own valley. Near the center is a local maximum around (−0.27; −0.92), f ≈ 181.6. The function rises toward the corners, reaching 890 at (5; 5).

03-rejilla.svg.Puntos que puede representar una cadena: Points a binary string can represent in the Himmelblau box
03-rejilla.svg.Tres cuadrados con los puntos de la reji: Three squares with grid points for k = 3, 4, and 5 bits per variable (64, 256, and 1024 points). None of the function's four global minima lies on a grid point. The best point in each grid is marked by a blue circle, with value 1.50, 0.91, and 0.30.

03-saltos-hamming.svg.Bits que cambian al pasar de un entero a: Bits changed between consecutive integers in standard binary and Gray code
03-saltos-hamming.svg.Gráfica de barras para los números de 0: Bar chart for numbers from 0 to 15 with 4 bits. Standard binary changes between 1 and 4 bits between consecutive integers; all 4 change from 7 to 8. Gray code always changes exactly one bit.

04-cobertura.svg.Tres poblaciones de ocho individuos en l: Three populations of eight individuals in the box
04-cobertura.svg.Tres cuadrados con la caja dividida en 8: Three squares divided into 8 strips per axis. The uniform population leaves 4 vertical and 2 horizontal strips empty, shown shaded. Halton and Latin hypercube have one individual in every strip of each axis.
04-cobertura.svg.Franjas ocupadas: 4 en x₁ y 6 en x₂: Occupied strips: 4 in x₁ and 6 in x₂
04-cobertura.svg.Franjas ocupadas: 8 en x₁ y 8 en x₂: Occupied strips: 8 in x₁ and 8 in x₂

04-penalizacion.svg.Aptitud de cada individuo según el peso: Each individual's fitness as a function of penalty weight
04-penalizacion.svg.Rectas de aptitud F = valor − λ · e de l: Fitness lines F = value − λ · e for 8 individuals, with λ from 0 to 5. The four that fit are horizontal; the other four descend with slope equal to excess weight. Below λ* = 4, I1, which does not fit, is best; above it, I5, which fits and has value 20, is best.

08-elitismo-parada.svg.Mejor aptitud de la población en cada ge: Best fitness in the population at each generation, with and without elitism
08-elitismo-parada.svg.OneMax de 40 bits, población de 20. Con: OneMax with 40 bits, population of 20. With one elite individual, best fitness never falls and reaches the optimum, 40, at generation 42. Without an elite, it rises and falls and does not reach the optimum within 100 generations. Generations 38 and 62 are marked: there the criteria of 10 and 20 generations without improvement would stop the run with an elite.

09-replicas.svg.Mejor longitud de ruta por generación en: Best route length per generation in 30 runs of the same algorithm
09-replicas.svg.Viajante con 20 destinos más el origen,: Traveling salesman with 20 destinations plus the origin, population of 30, pm = 0.05, and 30 runs with different seeds. The curves end between 50.3 and 78.0; the final mean is 62.6.

09-comparar-pm.svg.Longitud final de la mejor ruta en 30 ej: Final length of the best route in 30 runs for three values of pm
09-comparar-pm.svg.Cada punto es una ejecución. Medias: pm: Each dot is one run. Means: pm = 0.00: 80.1; pm = 0.05: 62.6; pm = 0.20: 55.4. The dot clouds for pm = 0.05 and pm = 0.2 overlap.

09-tamano.svg.Cuánto empeora cada valor de pm respecto: How much worse each value of pm is than the best, by problem size
09-tamano.svg.pm = 0,05 queda un 7 % por encima del me: pm = 0.05 is 7% above the best with 10 destinations, 21% above the best with 20 destinations, and 24% above the best with 30 destinations. The best value tested is the same for all three sizes, 0.5.
09-tamano.svg.Por encima de la mejor media del mismo t: Above the best mean for the same size

09-interaccion.svg.Longitud media final según pm para dos t: Mean final length by pm for two tournament sizes
09-interaccion.svg.Con torneo de 2, pm = 1 da 63,1 y pm = 0: With a tournament of 2, pm = 1 gives 63.1 and pm = 0.2 gives 55.2: raising pm makes things worse. With a tournament of 10, pm = 1 gives 48.8 and pm = 0.2 gives 55.8: raising pm helps.
09-interaccion.svg.Punto grande: el mejor de los cinco valo: Large dot: best of the five values. Bars: ± 2 standard errors.

10-mapa.svg.Mapa de seis lugares del capítulo 11 y l: The six-place map in this chapter and the best route
10-mapa.svg.Cuadrícula de 10 por 10 con el origen O: A 10 by 10 grid with the origin O at (0, 0) and five places: 1 at (7, 8), 2 at (5, 6), 3 at (1, 4), 4 at (2, 8), and 5 at (4, 6). The best route, O 3 4 1 2 5 O, has length 24.29.

10-generacion.svg.Una generación a mano: población inicial: One generation by hand: initial population and next population
10-generacion.svg.Arriba, las cuatro rutas de la población: Top, the four routes of the initial population with their lengths: A 30.62, B 27.81, C 32.53, and D 29.26. Bottom, the next population: B, which passes as the elite; D, copied; H1, a child of the crossover of B and A, 24.80; and H2, the mutated child of the crossover, 24.29, which is the best possible route.
10-generacion.svg.la ruta más corta de cada población: the shortest route in each population

11-metaheuristicas.svg.Un mapa de metaheurísticas, entre explor: A map of metaheuristics, between exploring and exploiting
11-metaheuristicas.svg.Una flecha horizontal va de explorar, o: A horizontal arrow runs from exploring, or diversifying, on the left, to exploiting, or intensifying, on the right. At the left end is random search, and at the right end, the local search that moves to the best neighbor. Between them are two boxes. The left one, population-based metaheuristics, tends to explore: evolutionary methods (genetic algorithms, highlighted, evolution strategies, genetic programming, differential evolution, and estimation of distribution) and swarm methods (ant colonies and particle swarms). The right one, trajectory-based metaheuristics, tends to exploit: simulated annealing, tabu search, iterated local search, variable neighborhood search, and GRASP. A brace under the two boxes indicates that hybrid methods, such as memetic algorithms, combine both.
11-metaheuristicas.svg.Híbridos: combinan las dos, como los alg: Hybrids: combine both, such as memetic algorithms

11-que-metodo.svg.¿Qué método uso? Una orientación en cuat: Which method should I use? A guide in four questions
11-que-metodo.svg.Cuatro preguntas en cascada. Primera: ¿e: Four cascading questions. First: is the space small? If so, check all the solutions. If not, second: is it smooth with a single peak? If so, a method that climbs the slope. If not, third: are there specific heuristics, as in the traveling salesman problem? If so, use them, alone or inside a metaheuristic. If not, a metaheuristic is needed, and the fourth question chooses which one: is it useful to combine parts of good solutions or to search with many at once, for example with several peaks or several objectives? If so, a population-based one, such as the genetic algorithm; if not, a trajectory-based one, such as local search, simulated annealing, or tabu search. The two can be combined in a memetic algorithm. Finally, in all cases, set the evaluation budget according to the horizon of the decision, strategic, tactical, or operational, and tune with cases similar to the real one.
11-que-metodo.svg.¿Es suave y con una sola cima?: Is it smooth with a single peak?
11-que-metodo.svg.el paisaje no tiene óptimos locales: the landscape has no local optima
11-que-metodo.svg.un problema muy estudiado, como el viaja: a well-studied problem, like the TSP
11-que-metodo.svg.Hace falta una metaheurística. ¿Cuál?: A metaheuristic is needed. Which one?
11-que-metodo.svg.o buscar con muchas a la vez: varias cim: or searching with many at once: several peaks or objectives
11-que-metodo.svg.En todos los casos: fija el presupuesto: In all cases: set the evaluation budget according to the horizon
11-que-metodo.svg.(estratégico, táctico u operativo) y aju: (strategic, tactical, or operational) and tune with cases similar to the real one

11-tipos-de-representacion.svg.Las cuatro representaciones del libro, d: The book's four representations, from chromosome to solution
11-tipos-de-representacion.svg.Cuatro paneles. Binaria: el cromosoma 1: Four panels. Binary: chromosome 1 0 1 1 0 1 puts items 1, 3, 4, and 6 into the knapsack; they weigh 10 of 10 and are worth 14. Integer: chromosome 2 1 3 2 1 distributes five tasks among three machines, with loads 7, 10, and 5 and makespan 10. Real: chromosome (3.00; 2.00) is the point (3; 2) of the Himmelblau function, one of its minima, with f = 0. Permutation: chromosome 1 3 5 2 6 4 is a tour through six cities of length 327.4.
